items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: I think, uh, Kid Thomas, I think, plays the horn very much like Mutt.

ctx.x: You say Bunk played as loud as Kid Thomas does? You know, when he's playing at a peak?

Oh, I think louder. I think louder. Lighter than Kid Thomas? Well, yeah, I think Bunk had a more piercing, uh, uh, tone. I mean, it's hard for me to recall now, but he, I know he cut through. I know the band was a very loud band, and there were times when there was a lot of talk, and, uh, a lot of, there were a whole lot of people, there'd be a whole lot of people on the Stuyvesant, a whole lot of talk, and the band would be very loud, and Bunk would just cut through, uh, without, I mean, without any doubt at…

I'm gonna just try to sort of jump around on some ideas. I hope it doesn't confuse you too much. But, you know, I'm getting them from Bill's former tape with it. What about Al Hanson? Did he give you any specific tips that he learned from Bunk?
